# Phase 5 — Fair comparison (generated by `utils/make_comparison_table.py`)

Protocol: LOG.md 'Phase 5 Comparison Plan — 2026-10-15T18:10:33Z'. Mean ± std (ddof=1) over seeds 0–4, test split, 2000 samples per model, unbiased estimators. Lower is better. Δ separated when |Δ| > 2 SE.

Paper-reported values: Fig. 3a / 3e plots only, not digitized: EVIDENCE_MISSING for numeric comparison; qualitative statements only (QCBM < RBM, random on BS; QCBM slightly < RBM on movies, polynomial).

Raw-count values of binary models (paper RBM, B6, B4, random) are PARTIALLY_COMMENSURABLE: they cannot emit the photon counts ≥ 2 present in 60% of test samples.
